name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard, shows 'Copied' for a moment and announces it.
a11y: Native button; the icon-only form is named by the label prop (default 'Copy').
The result is announced in a polite role=status region: 'Copied' or 'Copy failed'.
The text button changes its visible text to the copied label and resets itself.

props.name: value
props.description: The text written to the clipboard when the button is pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible text. Leave it out for an icon-only button that is named by `label`.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the icon-only button (the text button is named by its children). Default "Copy".

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: What is shown (text button) and announced to screen readers after a successful copy. Default "Copied".

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: What is announced when the browser refuses to copy. Default "Copy failed".

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long the copied state lasts, in milliseconds. Default 2000.

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Called with the copied text after a successful copy.

usage:
import {CopyButton} from '@monoline/react';
npm i @monoline/react Copy command
